'''Tarlam Central Square''' was a plaza in the settlement of [[Tarlam]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] that served as a courtyard to the settlement's [[City Hall]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Erkens]] and her staff were cornered and nearly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[isotope-5 droid]] in the square before being rescued.<ref name="TOR" />
